photos.c: Above: Aussie Mike "Mad Dog" Morgan was hoping to make the Commonwealth Games team for Wales in the Long Jump. Unfortunately he found out that they insist that their athletes must have competed in the Welsh Championships for at least two years. "It's bloody embarassing," he said, "I might have to consider becoming a flamin' Pom!
